theorems.name: Submission.ind_diagonal_weak_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (X : ℕ → ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Z : ℕ → TestFormOn U n → ℝ) (L : TestFormOn U n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), IsCompact (closure W) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun j => X k j ω) atTop (𝓝 (Z k ω))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun k => Z k ω) atTop (𝓝 (L ω))) → (∀ k, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (X k j).massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ k, (X k (φ k)).massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun k => X k (φ k) ω) atTop (𝓝 (L ω))
